''See also: [[Wei Shi Jaran Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Wei Shi Jaran is a member of the [[Wei clan]] and the father of Lindon{{!}}Wei Shi Lindon. He bears several physical marks from past combat, including a scar on his lip that gives him a permanent smirk and various other scars on his face and arms. He also suffers from a permanent limp that requires the use of a cane, though he has later been fully healed. Jaran is characterized by a blunt and sometimes scornful personality, often expressing frustration or using sharp wit. Despite his physical limitations, he remains a formidable and experienced warrior who values strategy and mental fortitude in combat. He has been involved in clan politics and disputes, occasionally defending his son's honor or challenging rivals. His family includes his wife, [[Seisha]], and his daughter, [[Kelsa]].}}
